notes:
PASS on the fake backend only: the gate printed the digest above with evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. This package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model, reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached, native.py was never imported or executed, and no upstream code was imported, installed or run.

SHAPE. The card's decision is direct-driver; the card also names the helper PythonObjectDriver. The real interface is a PyMoDAQ viewer plugin object whose data path is a Qt signal and whose wavelength axis and spectrum must be combined to pick one detector pixel, which a command table cannot express, so this package is a direct Driver over the same entry class. This is not a deviation from the card's decision.

WHAT IS EXPOSED. Reads: wavelength_min_nm, wavelength_max_nm, pixel_count and integration_time_ms. Write: integration_time_ms through the plugin's own exposure_time parameter and commit_settings hook (milliseconds converted by the plugin to controller microseconds). Action: cap.measure.intensity.v1 returns one scalar, the intensity of the detector pixel nearest to a declared wavelength (or of the brightest pixel when none is declared). cap.sensing.read.v1 from the card's hints binds sensor resource kinds; cap.measure.intensity.v1 binds instrument.spectrometer and is the class used. No x-cap id was needed, so there are no catalogue_requests.

NOT COVERED: the full spectrum array (the calibrated wavelengths and the intensity of every detector pixel). The upstream grab_data emits it as a DataToExport (src/pymodaq_plugins_oceaninsight/daq_viewer_plugins/plugins_1D/daq_1Dviewer_Omnidriver.py:142-162); the standard has no artifact transport for it, and this driver never returns the array. A reviewer who judges the array essential for this device should treat the package as NEEDS_ARTIFACTS rather than accept a truncated spectrum.

SCOPE. The MHS resource is the first discovered spectrometer (index 0). The plugin can discover several (...:79-91); the others are not exposed.

BOUNDS. Two operator_required limits: wavelength_nm (the axis is the detector calibration read at runtime, ...:130-134) and integration_time_ms (the plugin builds the exposure bounds from getMinimumIntegrationTime and getMaximumIntegrationTime, ...:93-95 and ...:110-111). Until the site overlay supplies both, calls carrying them are refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET. site-limits.example.json is an example for one bench, not a statement about any unit. No bound is copied from a constructor default or from a fake value.

SAFETY. Risk R1: the passive reads alone would be R0 and cap.measure.intensity.v1 is R0, but the writable cap.device.configure.v1 binding has an R1 class floor. The @estop calls the native stop(), which stops the averaging of every discovered spectrometer (...:168-173); the e-stop receipt reports the safe state achieved. R1 does not require SAFE-045's independent hardware e-stop, and none is claimed or cited.

WARNINGS. The only warning is G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for 'settings' (used by the driver): it is the PyMoDAQ Parameter tree owned by the external base class DAQ_Viewer_base/PluginBase, which is not in the clone, so the AST surface cannot list it; the upstream class itself uses self.settings at ...:82, ...:105 and ...:149, and the Fact for it cites ...:103-111. No G4 warning was raised.

FAKE. fake.py is an in-memory stand-in, not a recording. Every numeric start value is marked # placeholder and is test data only: 16 pixels, a 400-1000 nm axis, a 100 ms integration time and a canned 16-point spectrum. They are not a device fact, a Limit or a reference. The fake's public methods are the upstream class's get_xaxis, commit_settings, stop and close; its controller helper implements only controller methods the upstream class itself calls.

No network, no pip install, no hardware backend, no modification of the clone or the SDK. test_driver.py keeps the check_driver(HERE, backend='fake') call and adds nine repository cases.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-30; reviewed_by stays null): accepted; the reviewer changed no file of the package. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
